title: Hooks
shortDefinition: A hook is a leg or foot connection used to lift, pull, hold hip line, or off-balance.
whyItMatters: Live hooks power Guard Retention, butterfly, Back Control, and Single Leg X.
deepExplanation: A hook is not just placing a foot. It needs knee angle, instep or heel tension, and hip connection. Dead hooks get smashed; live hooks force posts and base adjustments.
beginnerView: Keep toes active and know whether the hook pulls or lifts.
advancedView: Use hooks as sensors: when they shift weight, switch sweep, wrestle-up, or retention.
